lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Stop right there Nix, [beat] because if you take one more step into this dark alleyway, you are going to regret it for the rest of your life!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Bruno, get out of my way right now! [beat] I have the principal’s secret folder and the police are literally seconds away from catching us!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: You think I'm here to stop you? [beat] Look around, idiot, I’m the only one who knows how to decode the encrypted files in that blue folder.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Why would a brainless bully like you know anything about Huda’s digital encryption, [beat] unless you've been working for her this whole time?

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Shut your mouth before I shut it for you, [beat] I’m not her pawn, I’m the one she stole those student bank records from last summer!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait, if these are bank records, [beat] then the principal isn't just grading papers, she’s actually funneling our tuition money into a private account.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Exactly, and if we don't get to the computer lab to upload this evidence right now, [beat] she’s going to erase the server and blame both of us.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: I knew I’d find you two bottom-feeders lurking in the shadows, [beat] trying to play hero with things you will never truly understand!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Principal Huda? How did you get behind us so fast, [beat] and why are you holding a master override key for the entire school security system?

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: This school is my kingdom, and you children are just [beat] temporary guests who have finally overstayed their welcome in my private files.

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: Nix, look at the security cameras on the wall, [beat] they aren't recording us, they're broadcasting a fake loop to the police dispatchers right now!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: She’s not calling the cops on us to arrest us, [beat] she’s locking the alley gates to make sure we never walk out of here with that folder!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: Hand over the blue folder now, or I’ll make sure your permanent records [beat] are the very least of your worries by tomorrow morning.
